# Promises: resolved by the embedder if present, skipped if absent. Once a name
# is here the fork has committed to shipping it. Add deliberately, never by
# reflex, and in the same commit that implements the entry point.
#
# The twelve ffi/capi-full adds on top of ffi/capi, plus the ABI version query.
servo_rendering_context_create_native
servo_rendering_context_set_window
servo_rendering_context_take_window
servo_rendering_context_clone
servo_webview_resize
servo_webview_notify_input_event
servo_webview_notify_scroll_event
servo_webview_focus
servo_webview_blur
servo_webview_focused
servo_webview_builder_set_hidpi_scale_factor
servo_webview_set_hidpi_scale_factor
servo_capi_abi_version
# The second half of drawing. servo_webview_paint renders into the context's
# surface; without present that surface is never shown.
servo_rendering_context_present
# Sizes the surface. servo_webview_resize sizes the page; they are different
# sizes and the surface must be sized first.
servo_rendering_context_resize
# The slow path of reading a context: a CPU copy of the last presented frame, on
# every context type. An embedder composites from it where a shared surface is
# not available.
servo_rendering_context_read_frame
# Lets a library embedder service the content-process re-exec. Without it the
# child is the host's binary, which has never heard of --content-process.
servo_content_process_main
# Installs the embedder's own script into every document a webview loads.
servo_webview_builder_add_script
servo_webview_add_script
# Runs a script once in the document a webview shows now.
servo_webview_evaluate_javascript
# Accepts a script-requested new browsing context.
servo_webview_accept_new
# Says which feature set this payload was built with.
servo_capi_build_features
# An off-screen rendering context on a texture shared with one named process.
# create_shared alone is unusable: the handle is reachable only through
# shared_info, so the two are classified together. Exported on every platform;
# implemented on Windows, and an error return elsewhere until each platform's
# surface lands.
servo_rendering_context_create_shared
servo_rendering_context_shared_info
servo_rendering_context_shared_add_consumer
servo_rendering_context_shared_consumer_info
servo_rendering_context_shared_remove_consumer
# Answers a request_permission delegate call.
servo_webview_respond_permission
# Names the content process serving a webview's top-level document.
servo_webview_content_process_id
